decisions.reason: Building on the established glass-silicon wafer portfolio and aligned with advanced packaging trends, it likely meets the firm's aspirations and remains within core capabilities.
A carrier wafer for smaller diameters is close to the firm's existing handling products, and organizational slack allows continued carrying while results remain acceptable.
As a flagship copper interposer glass wafer central to the stated strategic direction, managerial commitment and slack make withdrawal unlikely.
The off-the-shelf Wafer Universe brand is a flagship close to the established offer, and its strategic focus strongly favors retention.
Distant from established capabilities and not presented as a flagship, any performance shortfall against aspirations likely triggers problemistic search and redeployment of resources.
